# Conclusions and Future Works

The developed error-recognition pipeline implements real-time hook-level visual inspection on a Raspberry Pi 3 using a lightweight LLR-based classifier.

On the independent test set of 771 images, the selected operating point achieves approximately:

| Metric | Value |
|---|---:|
| Accuracy | 97.4% |
| Detection probability | 85.5% |
| False-alarm probability | Approximately 0% |

## Future Work

The next developments for the vision subsystem are:

- multi-frame decision fusion;
- learned feature representations, such as lightweight CNNs;
- improved mechanical stability and camera alignment;
- integration of the detected alarm with the real ESP32/machine control workflow.
